parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The ID of the Global Accelerator instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Global Accelerator instance. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description:
The state of the Global Accelerator instance. Valid values:

- **init**: The instance is being initialized.

- **active**: The instance is active.

- **configuring**: The instance is being configured.

- **binding**: The instance is being bound.

- **unbinding**: The instance is being unbound.

- **deleting**: The instance is being deleted.

- **finacialLocked**: The instance is locked due to an overdue payment.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the Global Accelerator resource. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the Global Accelerator resource. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag values.
